title: FARDC-Wazalendo Push Toward Bitoy After Mahanga Recapture
detail: Government forces backed by Wazalendo fighters clashed with AFC/M23 rebels from the early morning of Saturday, Sept 12 at Bitoy, in the Butsike locality of Masisi's Nyamaboko I grouping, with light and heavy weapons fire reported in the area. The fighting followed FARDC-Wazalendo's Sept 11 recapture of the nearby Mahanga settlement after three days of battle, with the government coalition pressing its advance toward remaining AFC/M23 positions. No reliable casualty assessment was available as of the report, and neither FARDC nor AFC/M23 issued an official statement.

media.caption: FARDC and Wazalendo forces press toward AFC/M23 positions at Bitoy, near Mahanga in Masisi, Sept 12, 2026

confidenceReason: Corroborated by two independent Congolese outlets citing local sources; no FARDC or M23 confirmation and no casualty toll established.

title: Abandoned Explosive Device Kills Seven Farmers in Rutshuru's Gikoro
detail: An explosive device abandoned by unidentified persons detonated on Saturday, Sept 12 near Gikoro, in the Jomba grouping of Rutshuru territory, North Kivu, killing at least seven people — six at the scene and one during evacuation — and seriously injuring more than ten others, most of them farmers working their fields. Local sources linked the unexploded ordnance to past fighting between FARDC and AFC/M23 in the area, echoing a similar fatal blast at Kakono village in October 2025 and a UN warning from April 2025 about munitions proliferation in the conflict zone.
